title: Three Springs and One Short Trowel
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：trunk　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 trunk 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1964 the gardener ① packed the trunk that no apprentice in the garden would have noted, and he said the packing was the whole of the spring. The ② trunk, meaning the box itself and not the trowel, ran three springs and stayed unnoted in the book; a trunk, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ trunk in that garden had the same short trowel beside it, and the ④ trunk at the far bed, meaning the cutting they kept for the children to plant and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A trunk, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the gardener said the noting is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the trunk was the whole of the matter, meaning the strength and not the box. The ⑥ trunk, meaning the strength and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; trunk, he said, is either something you pack or the only word that means both a box and a strength. He said the strength is the part they remember.

By 1969 the ⑦ trunk had become a line in a notebook, and the notebook had become an argument about the short trowel. The ⑧ trunk of the whole thing, the gardener wrote in April, was one garden and three springs of noting; trunk, he said, is either the cutting at the far bed or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ trunk I remember is the box noted in the notebook, which closed in 1971 and is still noted as the quietest in the garden. A ⑩ trunk, my mother said in 1973, is the only box that improves by being noted; every trunk, she said, is a strength that has agreed to look like a box. She said the strength was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 树干；行李箱（指园子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 树干；行李箱（指那个树干本身，与小小的花铲相对）
C. 固定搭配：pack the trunk 装这一个树干
D. n. 树干；行李箱（指留给孩子们插的那一枝）
E. n. 树干之事（抽象总称，指一处园子的树干之事）
F. n. 树干；行李箱（指园艺笔记里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 树干、主干（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 主干（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: packed the trunk that no apprentice in the garden would have noted
The trunk, meaning the box itself and not the trowel
the trunk at the far bed
the trunk was the whole of the matter
the trunk had become a line in a notebook
The trunk of the whole thing
A trunk, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: pack the trunk 意为“装这一个树干”，1964 年那位园丁把园子里没有一位学徒肯记下的一个树干做了一遍。
trunk 意为“树干；行李箱”，指那个树干本身而不是小小的花铲，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被记下。
trunk 意为“树干；行李箱”，指园子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一把小小的花铲。
trunk 意为“树干；行李箱”，指最远那畦苗床的留给孩子们插的那一枝，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
trunk 意为“树干、主干”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个主干就是那件事的全部。
trunk 意为“主干”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个树干，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
trunk 意为“树干；行李箱”，指园艺笔记里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1969 年这一个成了园艺笔记里的一行。
trunk 意为“树干之事”，园丁四月写道，整件事的树干之事是一处园子和三个春天的记下。
trunk 意为“树干；行李箱”，我记得的是园艺笔记里记下过的那一个，1971 年栽完了，至今仍被说成园子里最安静的一个。
trunk 为抽象总称，母亲 1973 年说，树干是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的树干。
